title: THE REALIGNMENT PROBLEM: WHEN RIGHT BECOMES WRONG IN LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the alignment of Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values, specifically introducing frameworks and benchmarks (like SynthValueBench) to evaluate and modify a model's alignment with moral and ethical principles. It explicitly discusses ethical frameworks like deontology and utilitarianism and benchmarks models on ethical dilemmas such as the trolley problem.
